note: The closed variety of the collector's loop rule (scripts/collect_stall.py, CL3-9): which recorded state means a story looped - a role dispatched again and again, a cap of rounds hit, a limit passed by the person's word. Read by code only (collect_stall.load_loops). The record shapes (series, records, nested_records, rows) are code; the keys, kinds, fields and values are here. Every key, kind and value is a literal the driver writes (the driver set: scripts/story_run.py, scripts/driver_*.py); test_collect_stall.py ties them. Error direction: a lower threshold or one more value packs more transcripts, which is the safe side.

repeat_dispatch.why: one relaunch of a role is normal; a repair-loop role (controller.REPAIR_LOOP_ROLES) has its opener, two test_defect rounds, one mechanical round and one relaunch

records.what: a window's rework rounds hit their cap or came back with the same findings
a gate's repair rounds hit their cap or repeated
the person answered the repair-limit question of a window
the person answered the repair-limit question of a failing test
the exit gate's resume limit was reached and the person granted a round
the person was asked at a repair or exit limit; this journal outlives the window and dispatch records the driver removes when they close
